tasks.short: Create and maintain wind farm layouts and schematics.

steps.what: Assemble and verify actual wind farm survey and equipment revision inputs
Choose wind farm layout and schematic changes
Create wind farm layouts and schematics in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}
Check the final wind farm layout, schematic references and revision
outputs: checked final wind farm visual documentation

steps.what: Save the checked final wind farm drawing revision
inputs: checked final wind farm visual documentation

tasks.design: Test native survey references, reusable symbols and linked layouts in the engineering drawing system {OTHER}. Reuse actual approved source revisions; the engineer still chooses locations and checks the complete final drawings before saving them in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Wind farm revisions can repeat source imports, symbols and layout references.
tasks.enabler_now: Native external references and reusable drawing components can reduce repeated imports and drawing entry.
tasks.still_hard: Terrain, electrical design, access, setbacks and construction conflicts need engineering judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer sees whether a technically valid drawing is buildable on the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Less drawing repetition; layout authority remains unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering drawing tools support external references and reusable symbols; actual field compatibility and revision control must be tested.

assumptions: Boundary is creation or maintenance of actual layouts and visual documentation, through a checked saved revision. Source surveying and specialist approvals are supplied by their actual producers; no avoided labour is claimed for them.

Surveyor supplies coordinates, elevation, coordinate reference system and survey revision; equipment designer supplies actual equipment identifier, envelope and connection points. The engineer checks them in s1; unsupported source formats and missing fields stay manual. No free digitisation is assumed.
Test native drawing references before custom code. Existing linked sources and drawing runtime earn no labour saving. Source assessment and all layout decisions remain human.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. The routine save is one percent fully retained; s4 is the existing final drawing check.
unknowns: Are surveys and schematics already referenced natively?
What drawing entry is repeated on actual revisions?
research_questions: Does reference reuse reduce revision entry without masking coordinate or source-version changes?

incremental.description: Maintain drawing references, symbols and source-format checks.

approvals.approved_version: s4 checked final wind farm visual documentation, exact revision and document destination; changes require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.30 source entry + 35*0.40 drawing entry = 18.5; minus 1 upkeep = 17.5. If half the references and drawing components can be reused, 9.25 minus 1 = 8.25. No layout judgement or save saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend changes to wind turbine processes and infrastructure.

steps.what: Collect and verify actual wind turbine performance, cost and compliance evidence
Prepare comparison charts from verified turbine measurements and costs
Evaluate process or infrastructure changes and choose justified turbine recommendations
Write the recommendation explanation with actual evidence and qualifications

loop.purpose: Draft an explanation of engineer-chosen turbine changes
loop.input: Chosen changes, verified measurements, costs and limitations
loop.check: Engineer checks causal meaning, omitted operating conditions, unsupported savings and compliance claims against actual evidence
loop.stop: Missing evidence or two failed revisions returns the prose to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Use native charts and fixed headings first; the explanation varies with the engineer's findings

steps.what: Check the final recommendation, evidence, disclosure scope and recipients
Save the checked final wind turbine recommendation
Send the checked turbine recommendation to actual internal decision makers
Explain turbine recommendations and discuss actual operational trade-offs

tasks.design: Use existing exports from {OPS_SYSTEM}, cost fields and linked charts in {SPREADSHEET} before adding a bounded draft of the chosen recommendation in {DOCS}. The engineer evaluates causes and options, checks the final recommendation and recipients, saves and sends it separately and explains the trade-offs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Performance and cost evidence can need repeated collection and chart preparation before engineering review.
tasks.enabler_now: Native exports and chart links can reuse actual verified rows; bounded prose drafting follows the engineer's chosen changes.
tasks.still_hard: A correlation does not establish a fault cause, a compliance requirement or an achievable operating saving.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether a change fits the turbine, site, evidence and operational constraints.
tasks.altitude: Less evidence assembly; recommendation and change authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: operations exports and linked charts can support turbine review; source-linked language drafting still needs engineering verification.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual evidence assembly, recommendations and their written and oral communication. Implementation and regulatory approval remain their actual owners' work; no avoided implementation or other-role labour is claimed.

Operations records supply actual turbine identifier, timestamp, operating state, power and event codes; finance records supply actual cost identifier, period and amount. The engineer checks joins, units, missing periods and applicable requirement versions in s1. Missing mappings and free-text events stay manual; chart inputs are verified before s2.

Test native exports and linked charts first. Existing dashboards earn no new labour saving. All cause assessment, legal interpretation and choice of changes stay in s3; actual prose correction is counted in s4.

Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines or promises of turbine cost reduction. Save and send each retain their one percent share; recommendations do not authorise machine control changes.
unknowns: Which measurements and costs are already assembled automatically?
Are actual turbine identifiers consistent across systems?
research_questions: Does a checked native export reproduce current review evidence without extra manual reconciliation?

already_counted.description: Correct generated explanation and source meaning in s4.

incremental.description: Maintain evidence joins, charts and recommendation drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final turbine recommendation and document destination; edits require recheck
s5 checked final turbine recommendation and exact internal recipients; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.50 evidence entry + 15 chart entry + 14*0.30 prose = 29.2; minus 2 upkeep = 27.2. If half of this preparation is eligible, 14.6 minus 2 = 12.6. Judgement, dialogue and save/send time stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Model wind farm roads, collection and transmission infrastructure.

steps.what: Verify actual terrain, access, electrical and planning constraints for wind farm models
Choose infrastructure model structure and candidate access or collection layouts
outputs: chosen infrastructure model structure and candidates

steps.what: Create infrastructure model geometry and fields in the engineering modelling system {OTHER}
inputs: chosen infrastructure model structure and candidates

steps.what: Set up and compare candidate layout cases in the engineering solver {OTHER}
Interpret model limits and check the final recommended infrastructure layout model
outputs: checked final infrastructure model and interpretation

steps.what: Save the checked final infrastructure model revision
inputs: checked final infrastructure model and interpretation

tasks.design: Configure terrain references, reusable model objects and case parameters in the engineering modelling system {OTHER} first. The engineer selects candidate roads, crane routes or electrical layouts, defines the objective and constraints, and checks the final model interpretation before saving it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Infrastructure alternatives can repeat geometry and scenario input entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native model references and reusable case definitions can reduce that entry without changing model judgement.
tasks.still_hard: Crane movement, ground conditions, electrical loading and consent constraints require multidisciplinary judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer rejects an apparently optimal layout when the model omits a real site constraint.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated model setup; modelling and siting authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: engineering modelling tools can reuse referenced terrain, objects and case parameters; no automatic wind farm optimum or labour baseline is established.

assumptions: Boundary is model creation and assessment through a checked saved version. Physical construction and permit decisions are not model outputs and have no claimed avoided labour.

Survey producer supplies coordinates, elevations and revision; crane supplier supplies actual envelope and load limits; electrical designer supplies loads and connection constraints. The engineer verifies inputs in s1 and selects case values in s2-s4. Missing or incompatible fields are entered manually; no free survey conversion is assumed.

Test native references and case configuration before code. Existing solver runtime is not focal-role labour and earns no saving. Only repeated geometry and case entry change, not model choice or result interpretation.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. The final save has one percent fully retained time; s5 is the existing model check.
unknowns: Which engineering tools already reuse geometry and case parameters?
Are crane and terrain constraints available in compatible formats?
research_questions: Can actual prior cases be reproduced with reusable inputs and unchanged engineering checks?

incremental.description: Maintain reusable model objects and case parameter mappings.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final infrastructure model and interpretation, exact revision and document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross is 20*0.40 model entry + 15*0.40 case entry = 14; subtract 1 upkeep = 13. With half those repeated fields eligible, 7 minus 1 = 6. Solver runtime and engineering decisions supply no labour saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Find actual prototype wind turbine drawings, test results and applicable references
Assess prototype behaviour and provide engineering technical support to designers
outputs: actual prototype engineering advice and qualifications

steps.what: Write and check actual prototype support conclusions and evidence references
inputs: actual prototype engineering advice and qualifications

steps.what: Save the checked actual prototype support record

tasks.design: Configure prototype identifier and revision filters in {DOCS} and reuse checked source references in the existing support record. The engineer reads the actual evidence, works with designers on the technical issue and writes and checks the conclusions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prototype support can require finding several drawing and test revisions and entering their references again.
tasks.enabler_now: Native filters and linked document fields can reduce retrieval and repeated metadata entry.
tasks.still_hard: Prototype behaviour may differ from design assumptions and needs specialist interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer spots gaps in the evidence and explains a defensible next engineering step.
tasks.altitude: Less retrieval work; prototype design and support authority remain unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: controlled document filters and reference fields can support retrieval and support-note metadata; engineering technical advice remains human.

assumptions: Boundary includes the engineer's actual support and existing written conclusions. Do not add a support report to oral-only exchanges; observe and reweight that branch. Designer labour is outside this denominator.

Designers supply the actual question and prototype identifier; document owners supply actual drawing/test identifier, revision and source location. The engineer verifies source relevance in s1 and supplies actual conclusions in s2-s3. Missing fields stay manual.

Test native search and linked fields before custom code. Existing indexed retrieval earns no saving. Source reading remains within s1 and technical support stays fully retained; s3 reduction concerns only repeated source and context fields.
Shares are provisional scenarios, not measured baselines. Same-system save is one percent fully retained; the existing record check supplies its gate without an extra approval step.
unknowns: How often is prototype support documented?
Are actual prototype and revision identifiers consistent?
research_questions: Does native filtering reduce source finding without changing time spent understanding prototype behaviour?

incremental.description: Maintain prototype search filters and reference fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final prototype support record and exact document destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 retrieval + 9*0.20 repeated fields = 7.8; subtract 0.5 upkeep = 7.3. With half the retrieval and repeated fields eligible, 3.9 minus 0.5 = 3.4. Advice and save time stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Engineering siting, modelling and prototype decisions stay with the engineer while repeated source and drawing entry can shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Formal decision rights stay unchanged; prove reduced re-entry on actual wind farm revisions and reviews.
